_about: Logos on the /partners/ logo wall (files in assets/img/partners2/). A logo renders publicly only once its status is "approved": set status, confirmedBy (who confirmed permission with the brand) and confirmedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). Pending logos show on dev with a Pending tag and are cut from prod builds by deploy-sweep.py. build-sections.py reads this file; order here is the order on the page.
